label: All Cloaks give Hearts
summary: Every cloak (not just the Blood Cloak) turns damage Alucard survives into hearts, at one heart per 5 damage; with No Cape there are no hearts.

edits.why: 'beqz v0' -> 'bnez v0': hearts are given unless No Cape is worn
Divider cave: divu a0,t0; j AddHearts 0x800FE914; mflo a0 Lives in item-text padding: only installed where those bytes are free (zero).

vanilla.reason: The divide-by-5 code sits in spare space after ASS's shortened Curry Rice description; in vanilla those bytes are the end of that description text.

tunables.why: Cave in text padding; not used for detection (vanilla and 1.3.1 hold description text here).

notes: off for 0x3E3F4 is 12 zero bytes (string padding after 'Heals 1200HP (muse)'), not the 1.3.1 bytes, because the Curry Rice description was shortened separately by a text edit; the cave is only reached through 0x5EE0C. RISK: lengthening the Curry Rice (item 0x35) description in the Stats Editor past 0x3E3F3 would overwrite the cave and crash on a hit while wearing a cloak; the editor should treat DRA 0x3E3F4-0x3E3FF as reserved while this is on. The Blood Cloak rename at DRA 0x3F1C0 ('Scarlet' -> 'Blood Cloak') is name text, not part of this toggle. The superseded SotN-All-Cloaks-Hearts-Damage-Divided-By-4 PPF (srl a0,2 at 0x5EE10) is not in the image.
